ios.desc:
GitBiased turns the engineering signals scattered across GitHub into a calm dashboard you can shape around the way you work.

Build dashboards from focused widgets for pull requests, CI checks, issues, deployments, releases, repository activity, and DORA metrics. Choose the repositories each widget can see and keep every signal close without opening another browser tab.

WITH GITBIASED YOU CAN

• Build and switch between custom dashboards
• Monitor new and aging pull requests
• Spot failing and flaky workflows
• Track issues by severity
• Review releases, deployments, and DORA trends
• Search synced repositories and open detailed overviews
• Follow recent team activity
• Receive optional push notifications and weekly summaries
• Protect your account with authenticator-app two-factor authentication
• Share read-only dashboard links

PRIVACY-FIRST GITHUB ACCESS

GitBiased uses dedicated GitHub Apps with read-only, capability-specific permissions. During installation, GitHub lets you choose the repositories GitBiased can access. GitBiased cannot modify your repositories.

Sign in with email and password, GitHub, or Apple. You can disconnect integrations, control notifications, and permanently delete your account and synced GitBiased data from Settings.

A GitHub account and internet connection are required for GitHub-backed features. GitBiased is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitHub.

quotes.text:
Hi all.

I'm working on GitBiased platform. Basically the idea is to let you or your team (manager) know what is happening at the moment in your development life.

I myself use it lot, for having PRs of all my GitHub projects in one place. Also you can enable weekly mail with all things you have done for the previous week.

Permission-wise each widget requires its own permissions. At the moment we do not require any write permissions first of all and none of them allow to read the code of the repo(s).

I'm writing this post because I've recently released iOs version of the app.

https://gitbiased.com
https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/gitbiased/id6782933062
